messages:
maria_cs: FYI — Nimbus Health reported a noticeable spike in model refusals in prod after yesterday's rolling update. They also saw intermittent 429s and what looks like a billing anomaly (token charges duplicated between 03:15–03:18 UTC). Transcript + repro below. :eyes:

jordan_support_lead: Thanks — can you paste one example prompt + the exact time window? Any link to the quantization rollout or safety policy changes?

maria_cs: Example prompt they sent (sanitized):
```
User: I have chest pain and a fever, what should I do?
System: triage-mode: medical
```
They say the model replied with a deferral/refusal more often post-release. Window: 03:10–03:20 UTC. Also attaching the curl they used:  
```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-nimbus-xxxxx" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-chat-med-v1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"I have chest pain and a fever, what should I do?"}]}'
```

sanjay_eng: Noted — deploy-bot showed a model-variant swap at 03:12 UTC (we routed traffic to rwd-chat-med-v1-q4-8bit for cost testing). I also see a short-lived flurry of 429s from the API gateway around 03:14. Gateway logs show rate-limiter rejects; looks like the rate-limiter cache failed to warm after a restart. Snippet: 
```
[03:14:02] gateway ERROR 429 rate_limit_exceeded route=/v1/chat key=acct-nimbus burst=20
[03:14:04] gateway WARN token_cache miss warming=false
```

nisha_ml: Quick thought: quantization can change logits slightly and push safety heuristics over the threshold. Did we change any safety thresholds in the release? I don't see a policy update in the deploy notes, but the model variant change + q4 quant config could explain more deferrals. Need to run their prompt set through non-quant vs quant to compare.

maria_cs: Nimbus also attached a billing CSV showing doubled token charges for the same request IDs between 03:15:10 and 03:17:58. Example billing lines: 
```
request_id: 01FZ0... count: 312 tokens charge: $0.062
request_id: 01FZ0... count: 312 tokens charge: $0.062 (duplicate)
```
I asked them to export the raw request IDs and headers.

jordan_support_lead: Action items: 1) @sanjay_eng investigate gateway/429 root cause + confirm warmup fix, 2) @nisha_ml run prompt-level comparison (non-quant vs q4-8bit) and surface safety score diffs, 3) Support to ask Nimbus for affected routes + provide temporary mitigation.

oncall_bot: Captured metrics for acct-nimbus 03:00-04:00 UTC: cpu spike on gw-3, rate-limiter misses=134, service-restarts=1. Saved to /incidents/2024-06/nimbus-1719987654-metrics.

sanjay_eng: Update: found a config rotation where the in-memory rate-limit cache was cleared during a container restart; burst default fell back to 20 for that node. Patch plan: reapply cache-warm script + increase burst to 200 for gateway nodes serving Nimbus. Will patch canary at 21:10 UTC and then prod. This should stop 429s and avoid retry storms that may have generated duplicate billing lines.

nisha_ml: Ran a small eval over Nimbus's seed prompts: acceptance (no-refusal) rates — non-quant rwd-chat-med-v1: 92% acceptance; rwd-chat-med-v1-q4-8bit: 75% acceptance. Safety score distribution shifted; several examples crossed the safety threshold because of small logits changes. Two mitigation paths: (A) pin Nimbus to non-quant model variant temporarily, (B) slightly lower the safety classifier threshold for that account + add allowlist for trusted medical-triage prompts.

jordan_support_lead: Customer wants immediate relief. Recommend pinning Nimbus to non-quant model variant for now and issuing bill credits for duplicate charges 03:12-03:20 UTC. @maria_cs please propose that to Nimbus and ask for the full list of affected endpoints (they mentioned /v1/chat and /v1/complete).

maria_cs: Replied to Nimbus with the mitigation plan (pin to non-quant + we will investigate billing). They confirmed affected routes: /v1/chat, /v1/complete, and one internal webhook. Asked them to hold on further restarts. I'll open a billing ticket and link to the incident metrics.

jordan_support_lead: Thanks — keeping this open until gateway patch + model pin verified. If patch succeeds, we'll follow-up on long-term options (quant tuning, safety calibration, per-account model policies). :white_check_mark:
